seats.ENDER: Return P0/P1 ordinary-human defects with route, exact visible pattern, consequence, and smallest repair rule. End with HUMAN_GO, PATCH, or STOP.
seats.BEAN: Return P0/P1 false custody, trust, provider, privacy, or agreement claims with exploit and invariant. End with TRUST_GO, PATCH, or STOP.
seats.SKYBRO: Return the three largest value discontinuities and one smallest compounding-value repair. End with VALUE_GO, PATCH, or STOP.
seats.LADY_JESSICA: After implementation, independently walk and hash the exact candidate. Return LJ_RELEASE_REVIEW_GO, PATCH, or STOP; do not push without three keys.

transportTruth: Packet authored. Delivery, response, receipt validation, and assimilation remain separate states.
hardStop: No push, deploy, provider action, credentials, schema/RLS, production mutation, spend, new environment, subagent, or invented receipt.
